songs.title: Bulletproof
songs.description: Sticks and stones may break your bones — but what if they couldn't? A cinematic reimagining of the childhood phrase most people dismissed, Bulletproof flips the narrative into something harder, darker, and unshakeable. Hip-hop with an artistic edge, scored like a film.
